---
title: "Q2c_JUV_genetic_diversity_models_field"
author: "Kiran Bajaj"
date: "2026-08-23"
output: pdf_document

This file addresses Q2c: the direct effect of offspring genetic diversity (heterozygosity, allelic richness) on oyster survival, shell length, and condition index at each field timepoint, **including both monoculture and polyculture treatments**. The mixed-origin groups (H1-HYBRIDMIX, H2-SEEDMIX) are included here because this approach uses only genetic diversity, which they have, and no environment-of-origin, which they lack. This is the only Q2 approach that can include the polyculture groups.

260915 KEB: model structure matches Q2a/Q2b. The genetic predictors (ho, ar) are constant within source group, so a group-level random effect would be collinear with the fixed effects; survival is therefore plain `lm` (no random effect), and length and condition index use `lmer` with only a bag random effect `(1|bags_label)` to capture non-independence of individuals within a bag. Predictors vary across only 10 source groups, so effects have low power; non-significant results mean "undetectable at this replication," not "absent."

NOTE: the two mix groups have the highest heterozygosity values in the dataset, so they carry leverage on the ho slope. Any significant ho effect should be checked with a with-vs-without-mix-groups sensitivity refit before interpreting it as a diversity gradient rather than a mix-vs-mono contrast.

## Read in data

```{r}
surv_mod_ord_rename     <- read.csv("data/performance_H2F/field_surv_all_times.csv")[, -1]
lengths_mod_narm_nodead <- read.csv("data/performance_H2F/field_length_all_times.csv")[ ,-1]
ci_df                   <- read_csv("data/performance_H2F/MVP_phenotyping_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# juvenile genetics — 10 groups, INCLUDING SEEDMIX and HYBRIDMIX
juv_genetics <- read.csv("results/juvenile_effects_H2F/juvenile_genetic_effects_full.csv")
```

## Data preparation

The three data sources label the mix groups differently, so they are recoded to a
common convention (H1-HYBRIDMIX / H2-SEEDMIX) before merging. The `stopifnot` guard
halts if any merge silently drops a group.

```{r}
colnames(juv_genetics) <- c("pop", "ho", "exp_hs", "ar")

# genetics file uses bare SEEDMIX / HYBRIDMIX -> match performance labels
juv_genetics$pop <- recode(juv_genetics$pop,
  "SEEDMIX" = "H2-SEEDMIX", "HYBRIDMIX" = "H1-HYBRIDMIX")

# survival + genetics (mix groups retained — do NOT exclude)
surv_mod_gen <- merge(surv_mod_ord_rename, juv_genetics, by = "pop")

# length + genetics
len_mod_gen <- merge(lengths_mod_narm_nodead, juv_genetics, by = "pop")

# condition index: build frame, recode hybrid label (CI data calls it H1-LARMIX), then merge
ci_sub <- ci_df %>%
  mutate(population = as.character(population)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(population), population != "NA") %>%
  transmute(
    ci         = CI,
    t          = fct_recode(as.factor(samplingTimePoint), t1 = "2023-11", t2 = "2024-05", t3 = "2024-11"),
    bag_site   = fct_recode(as.factor(site), Lewisetta = "LEW", YorkRiver = "YR"),
    pop        = population,
    bags_label = bagID
  )
ci_sub$pop <- recode(ci_sub$pop, "H1-LARMIX" = "H1-HYBRIDMIX")
ci_gen <- merge(ci_sub, juv_genetics, by = "pop")

# GUARD: all three frames must carry all 10 groups
stopifnot(
  length(unique(surv_mod_gen$pop)) == 10,
  length(unique(len_mod_gen$pop))  == 10,
  length(unique(ci_gen$pop))       == 10
)

# confirm structure
table(surv_mod_gen$pop, surv_mod_gen$bag_site)
```

## Survival ~ ho + ar  (plain lm)

```{r}
surv_lew_t1 <- surv_mod_gen[surv_mod_gen$t == 1 & surv_mod_gen$bag_site == "Lewisetta", ]
surv_G1.lew <- lm(surv ~ ho + ar, data = surv_lew_t1); summary(surv_G1.lew)
surv_t1_lew_scaled <- lm(scale(surv) ~ scale(ho) + scale(ar), data = surv_lew_t1)

surv_lew_t2 <- surv_mod_gen[surv_mod_gen$t == 2 & surv_mod_gen$bag_site == "Lewisetta", ]
surv_G2.lew <- lm(surv ~ ho + ar, data = surv_lew_t2); summary(surv_G2.lew)
surv_t2_lew_scaled <- lm(scale(surv) ~ scale(ho) + scale(ar), data = surv_lew_t2)

surv_lew_t3 <- surv_mod_gen[surv_mod_gen$t == 3 & surv_mod_gen$bag_site == "Lewisetta", ]
surv_G3.lew <- lm(surv ~ ho + ar, data = surv_lew_t3); summary(surv_G3.lew)
surv_t3_lew_scaled <- lm(scale(surv) ~ scale(ho) + scale(ar), data = surv_lew_t3)

surv_yrk_t1 <- surv_mod_gen[surv_mod_gen$t == 1 & surv_mod_gen$bag_site == "YorkRiver", ]
surv_G1.york <- lm(surv ~ ho + ar, data = surv_yrk_t1); summary(surv_G1.york)
surv_t1_yrk_scaled <- lm(scale(surv) ~ scale(ho) + scale(ar), data = surv_yrk_t1)

surv_yrk_t2 <- surv_mod_gen[surv_mod_gen$t == 2 & surv_mod_gen$bag_site == "YorkRiver", ]
surv_G2.york <- lm(surv ~ ho + ar, data = surv_yrk_t2); summary(surv_G2.york)
surv_t2_yrk_scaled <- lm(scale(surv) ~ scale(ho) + scale(ar), data = surv_yrk_t2)

surv_yrk_t3 <- surv_mod_gen[surv_mod_gen$t == 3 & surv_mod_gen$bag_site == "YorkRiver", ]
surv_G3.york <- lm(surv ~ ho + ar, data = surv_yrk_t3); summary(surv_G3.york)
surv_t3_yrk_scaled <- lm(scale(surv) ~ scale(ho) + scale(ar), data = surv_yrk_t3)

# save survival results
sink(paste0("results/juvenile_effects_H2F/models/survival_Q2c_genetics_results_", Sys.Date(), ".txt"))
for (nm in c("surv_G1.lew","surv_G2.lew","surv_G3.lew","surv_G1.york","surv_G2.york","surv_G3.york")) {
  cat("\n", nm, "\n"); print(summary(get(nm)))
}
for (nm in c("surv_t1_lew_scaled","surv_t2_lew_scaled","surv_t3_lew_scaled","surv_t1_yrk_scaled","surv_t2_yrk_scaled","surv_t3_yrk_scaled")) {
  cat("\n", nm, "(scaled)\n"); print(summary(get(nm)))
}
sink()
```

## Length ~ ho + ar + (1|bags_label)

```{r}
len_lew_t1 <- len_mod_gen[len_mod_gen$t == 1 & len_mod_gen$bag_site == "Lewisetta", ]
len_G1.lew <- lmer(length ~ ho + ar + (1 | bags_label), data = len_lew_t1)
isSingular(len_G1.lew); VarCorr(len_G1.lew); summary(len_G1.lew)
```

## Figures

```{r}
# lm (survival): residual df from df.residual()
build_slope_df_lm <- function(m_t1, m_t2, m_t3) {
  bind_rows(
    tidy(m_t1) %>% mutate(t = "t1", df = df.residual(m_t1)),
    tidy(m_t2) %>% mutate(t = "t2", df = df.residual(m_t2)),
    tidy(m_t3) %>% mutate(t = "t3", df = df.residual(m_t3))
  ) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(tmult = qt(0.975, df),
           lower = estimate - tmult * std.error,
           upper = estimate + tmult * std.error) %>%
    select(explanatory = term, slope = estimate, lower, upper, t)
}

# lmer (length, CI): Satterthwaite df from tidy()
build_slope_df_lmer <- function(m_t1, m_t2, m_t3) {
  bind_rows(
    tidy(m_t1, effects = "fixed") %>% mutate(t = "t1"),
    tidy(m_t2, effects = "fixed") %>% mutate(t = "t2"),
    tidy(m_t3, effects = "fixed") %>% mutate(t = "t3")
  ) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(tmult = qt(0.975, df),
           lower = estimate - tmult * std.error,
           upper = estimate + tmult * std.error) %>%
    select(explanatory = term, slope = estimate, lower, upper, t)
}

# genetics-only: two predictors
y_limits <- c("scale(ho)", "scale(ar)")
y_labels <- c("Heterozygosity", "Allelic richness")
time_labels <- c("t1" = "November 2023", "t2" = "May 2024", "t3" = "November 2024")

plot_slopes <- function(df, point_color) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = slope, y = explanatory)) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = t, shape = t), color = point_color, size = 3.5,
               position = position_dodge2v(height = .85, reverse = T, preserve = "total")) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = upper, xmin = lower, alpha = t), color = point_color,
                   height = 0, size = 1.2, position = position_dodgev(height = -.85, preserve = "total")) +
    scale_alpha_manual(name = "Time", na.translate = F,
                       values = c("t1" = .45, "t2" = .7, "t3" = 1), labels = time_labels) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Time", na.translate = F,
                       values = c("t1" = 15, "t2" = 16, "t3" = 17), labels = time_labels) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.6, 2)) +
    xlab("Slope on scaled data") + ylab("Variable") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_discrete(name = "Explanatory variable", limits = y_limits, labels = y_labels) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 15))
}

# survival (lm)
p <- plot_slopes(build_slope_df_lm(surv_t1_lew_scaled, surv_t2_lew_scaled, surv_t3_lew_scaled), "#F06292"); p
ggsave("FigSx_lew_surv_genetics.pdf", p, device = "pdf", path = "figures/juvenile_effects_H2F", height = 4, width = 7)
p <- plot_slopes(build_slope_df_lm(surv_t1_yrk_scaled, surv_t2_yrk_scaled, surv_t3_yrk_scaled), "#880E4F"); p
ggsave("FigSx_york_surv_genetics.pdf", p, device = "pdf", path = "figures/juvenile_effects_H2F", height = 4, width = 7)

ggsave("FigSx_lew_length_genetics.pdf", p, device = "pdf", path = "figures/juvenile_effects_H2F", height = 4, width = 7)
```

## Check assumptions

```{r}
all_models <- list(
  "surv Lew t1"=surv_G1.lew,"surv Lew t2"=surv_G2.lew,"surv Lew t3"=surv_G3.lew,
  "surv Yrk t1"=surv_G1.york,"surv Yrk t2"=surv_G2.york,"surv Yrk t3"=surv_G3.york,
  "len Lew t1"=len_G1.lew,"len Lew t2"=len_G2.lew,"len Lew t3"=len_G3.lew,
  "len Yrk t1"=len_G1.york,"len Yrk t2"=len_G2.york,"len Yrk t3"=len_G3.york,
  "CI Lew t1"=ci_G1.lew,"CI Lew t2"=ci_G2.lew,"CI Lew t3"=ci_G3.lew,
  "CI Yrk t1"=ci_G1.york,"CI Yrk t2"=ci_G2.york,"CI Yrk t3"=ci_G3.york
)

op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
for (nm in names(all_models)) {
  m <- all_models[[nm]]
  plot(fitted(m), resid(m), main = paste(nm, "resid vs fitted"), xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residual", pch = 19, col = rgb(0,0,0,0.3)); abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
  qqnorm(resid(m), main = paste(nm, "QQ")); qqline(resid(m))
}
par(op)

sapply(all_models, function(m) c(shapiro_p = tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid(m))$p.value, error=function(e) NA),
                                 n = length(resid(m))))
```
